name: inline-context
description: The anchor for what an inline construct takes from the block around it. A codespan names a font of its own, so prawn re-selects the face for it and the block's ambient slant and weight never reach it — while emphasis markup around it does, because that arrives as fragment styles. The document puts a codespan in an italic caption, in a bold header column, in a bold heading, and inside `_em_` and `*strong*`, so the reference draws all four answers.
